title: Cow holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- Cow spots -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='56' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='74' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='44' y='74' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='56' y='74' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='68' y='74' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='84' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <rect x='44' y='84' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <rect x='56' y='84' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <rect x='68' y='84' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='32' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f5f0e6' transform='rotate(-20 32 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='32' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f5f0e6' transform='rotate(20 68 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='32' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b8b8' transform='rotate(-20 32 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='32' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b8b8' transform='rotate(20 68 32)'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='24' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e8d8a0' transform='rotate(-15 40 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='24' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e8d8a0' transform='rotate(15 60 24)'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a20'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a20'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f0b8b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='44' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#d98c8c'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='44' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#d98c8c'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 51 54 48' stroke='#c07070' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M28 58 Q22 52 28 46' stroke='#f5f0e6' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 58 Q78 52 72 46' stroke='#f5f0e6' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50 50 C48 42 38 40 36 46 C34 50 42 56 50 60 C58 56 66 50 64 46 C62 40 52 42 50 50 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff8fa3' transform='rotate(-25 44 46)'/>
</svg>
